text:
incident-bot: Pager -> SEV2: infer-edge-us1 pool: 6 nodes lost heartbeats, transitioned to NotReady; traffic spike of 5% 503s and median latency up ~220ms. Runbook: https://internal.runbooks/redwood/infer-node-heartbeat. Please ack. :rotating_light:

sarah.ng: acked, I'm on call. Starting triage.

jamal: looking at pod logs for model-serving pods on the affected nodes — seeing repeated GPU failures and container restarts. snippet: ```stderr: runtime error: CUDA error: out of memory
time="2026-03-17T09:10:12Z" level=error msg="container restartCount=5"```

maria: system logs from one node show abrupt NIC link flaps and nv_peer_mem errors at the same timestamps. syslog excerpt: ```Mar 17 09:09:58 node-17 kernel: mlx5_core 0000:3b:00.0: NIC link state changed to DOWN
Mar 17 09:10:00 node-17 kernel: nv_peer_mem: failed to register memory region````

thomas: quick mitigation proposal: 1) cordon + drain the affected nodes to avoid noisy restarts, 2) fail traffic to the dedicated fallback pool (dedicated-fallback-us1), 3) scale fallback by +3 nodes, 4) collect full dmesg + driver logs for postmortem. Any objections?

sarah.ng: agree. jamal you and infra-bot coordinate drains and scale. I'll update customers and slack status.

jamal: running commands now: ``kubectl cordon node-12 node-14 node-17`` -> marked unschedulable.
Then: ``kubectl drain node-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force`` -> evicted pods.

infra-bot: Autoscaling API: requested 3 nodes -> launching. New nodes joining cluster: node-58, node-59, node-60.

maria: switched routing in control plane: infer-edge-us1 -> weight 0, dedicated-fallback-us1 -> weight 100. API route change propagated. (console change id: rc-9921)

sarah.ng: customer-facing status updated: "Degraded - inference latency increased; routing to fallback initiated. No customer data loss." Posted on status.redwood.ai

jamal: after failover we see 503 rate drop to ~0.4% and p50 latency back near normal. Still collecting kernel crash dumps and GPU driver stacks.

ops-rotation: I'll own the follow-up postmortem and blameless RCA. Adding logs and runbook edits to the incident board.

infra-bot: Healthcheck: nodes node-12/node-14/node-17 show NotReady -> kubelet restarted multiple times; now kernel module updates pending.

sarah.ng: thanks team. We'll keep nodes drained until driver patches rolled and perform a controlled rejoin. Marking this thread resolved for on-call. Follow-up in #incidents with postmortem link when available. :white_check_mark:
